name: Seated machine leg curl
definition: Sit in a leg-curl machine with thighs restrained and lower legs against its pad. Bend both knees to move the pad through its curling path, then return.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.movement: Bend both knees to move the pad through its curling path, then return.
value.finish: Return to the defined extended-knee start.
value.range_of_motion: Use repeatable device stops; record seat/hip position and lever alignment.
